name: nyaysetu
description: NyaySetu (न्यायसेतु) — blockchain-anchored evidence, summons and bail infrastructure

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix contracts install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix contracts run build && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.audit: npm --prefix contracts audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix backend audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev
scripts.audit:all: npm --prefix contracts audit; npm --prefix backend audit; npm --prefix frontend audit
scripts.test:integrity: npm --prefix backend exec -- tsx --test packages/integrity/test/sha256.test.ts packages/integrity/test/manifest.test.ts packages/integrity/test/explain.test.ts packages/integrity/test/journal.test.ts
